notes: §1985:VIII.3.2.4 GR6: 'The VALUE OF clause for the Relative I-O module is the same as the VALUE OF clause for the Sequential I-O module', i.e. §1985:VII.3.9: VALUE OF {implementor-name-1 IS {data-name-1 | literal-1}} ..., data-name-1 unsubscripted, not an index item, and 'Data-name-1 must be in the Working-Storage Section.' (SR2), label checking the implementor's (no labels processed, docs/CONFORMANCE.md 3.7) and external entries 'must be consistent' (GR2) by the implementor's rule. CobolData.g4#valueOfClause/#valueOfEntry is the format, FileControlBinder#CaptureValueOf/#ResolveValueOfDataNames enforce SR1/SR2 (COBOL6849), ExternalFileConnectorRules#CheckFileDescriptions the documented consistency rule at 85 (COBOL6847), and VersionConformancePass#VisitValueOfClause refuses the clause from 2002 (COBOL0902). Probes at --std 85 on a relative file: VALUE OF FILE-ID IS "ABC" VOLUME IS WS-ID (RANDOM), FILE-ID IS WS-K, FILE-ID "A" FILE-ID "B", FILE-ID IS ZERO (DYNAMIC) compile and run (missing-file OPEN INPUT status 35, then 00 REC3); VALUE OF "ABC" with no implementor-name refused (COBOL5506); a file-section data-name refused (COBOL6849); EXTERNAL entries FILE-ID "A" vs "B" refused (COBOL6847), "A" vs IS "A" accepted; at --std 2002 refused COBOL0902. The witness runs a relative file under VALUE OF FILE-ID IS "RELDATA".
